The issue in the provided code is that the final calculation of `ans` is incorrect. The code is using `Math.min(r[i], r[i])` instead of `Math.min(l[i], r[i])`. This mistake results in the wrong maximum size of the Pyramid Sequence being calculated.

Here is the patch to fix the issue:

# modification 1
```
<file>faultyVersion.java</file>
<original>
			for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) ans = Math.max(ans, Math.min(r[i], r[i]));
</original>
<patched>
			for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) ans = Math.max(ans, Math.min(l[i], r[i]));
</patched>
```

This change ensures that the correct minimum value between the left and right arrays is used to calculate the maximum size of the Pyramid Sequence.
